system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 1-6 hours, 12 Spell Uses. Lasts: Until Recast. Locks or unlocks a door. More complex locks take more time, not more Spell Uses. Lockpicks can still work on it but take the same time. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
